fact: The Ultimate Post reports URA awarded an e-tax2 electronic tax software supply, installation and operationalization contract (80bn, 10-year) to a joint venture, meant to digitise tax administration, with the rollout late by 4 years and the contractor yet to start work.

The URA's File a Return page sets out logging in to the URA web portal with the taxpayer TIN, uploading a completed return template and submitting it, with an acknowledgement receipt emailed; as_of is the page's capture-month published date.
